# AJAYNXT Digital Studio

> Independent digital studio based in Sikar, Rajasthan, India, working with businesses in India and internationally. Services include website development, UI/UX, digital marketing, SEO, paid advertising, AI-assisted content and video production.

The official website is https://ajaynxt.com/. Public service pages describe the current scope and contact options. Website development starts from INR 10,000; UGC video production starts from INR 800 per video. Final quotes depend on scope and requirements. These are starting prices, not fixed package quotes.

## Services

- [Digital marketing](https://ajaynxt.com/services/digital-marketing/): Campaign strategy and performance marketing.
- [Google Ads](https://ajaynxt.com/services/google-ads/): PPC, keyword targeting and conversion tracking.
- [Meta Ads](https://ajaynxt.com/services/meta-ads/): Facebook and Instagram advertising.
- [SEO services](https://ajaynxt.com/services/seo/): Local, technical and on-page search optimisation.
- [SEO keyword research](https://ajaynxt.com/services/seo-keyword-research/): Search intent and competitor research.
- [AI content creation](https://ajaynxt.com/services/ai-content/): AI-assisted copy, scripts and content planning with human review.
- [UGC and video editing](https://ajaynxt.com/services/video-editing/): Creator-style videos, reels, Shorts and editing.
- [Social media marketing](https://ajaynxt.com/services/social-media/): Social creatives and content strategy.
- [Pinterest marketing](https://ajaynxt.com/services/pinterest-marketing/): Pin creatives, visual search and paid campaigns.
- [Website design](https://ajaynxt.com/services/website-design/): Responsive websites and landing pages.
- [E-commerce](https://ajaynxt.com/services/ecommerce/): Online stores and product experiences.
- [AI workflows](https://ajaynxt.com/services/ai-workflows/): AI-assisted business workflows.

## Portfolio

- [Projects](https://ajaynxt.com/projects.html): Client work and concept websites, separately identified.
- [UI/UX Showcase](https://ajaynxt.com/showcase.html): Interactive 3D, motion and website design concepts. Concepts are not client endorsements or commercial offers.
- [Case studies](https://ajaynxt.com/case-studies/): Selected project descriptions.
- [3D portfolio](https://ajaynxt.com/3d.html): Interactive portfolio experience.
